entries.name: marketing
entries.content: Marketing notes for Brightside Fixtures: money pages are /contact (form) and /thank-you (conversion). Consent banner is CookieYes with Consent Mode v2. Ad platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads. The offline-conversion lane is not opted in.

gtm.note: No GTM container is configured on this project; every tag is hardcoded in the site source (gtag.js, Meta pixel, UET). analytics_diagnose_tracking is the read for hardcoded tags.
